name: The Rolling Stones

whyMatters.en: British Invasion's dirtier Blues line: swing, danger, and proof a band can age for decades without going soft.
whyMatters.zh: British Invasion 更脏的那条 Blues 线：摇摆、危险，以及一支乐队可以老几十年却不软掉。

note.zh: fuzz riff：欲望与不满的全球钩子
Samba 脉搏遇上摇滚危险叙事
时代末感：六十年代的阴影高潮

interviewQuotes.text: It's only rock 'n' roll but I like it.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Mick Jagger

interviewQuotes.text: The music is the most important thing.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Keith Richards

lyricQuotes: Rape, murder, it's just a shot away

shortBio.en: British Invasion blues-hard line: swing, danger, lasting stage myth.
shortBio.zh: British Invasion 的 Blues 硬核路线：摇摆、危险与持久的舞台神话。

body.en:
If the Beatles are the workshop, the Stones are the street. They bring American Blues body-feel back to Britain and export dirtier guitars worldwide.

The long game is the point: danger as a brand that refuses to retire into polite nostalgia.
body.zh:
如果说 Beatles 是工坊，Stones 就是街道。他们把美国 Blues 的身体感带回英国，再以更脏的吉他输回全球。

长期主义才是论点：危险做成品牌，拒绝退休成礼貌怀旧。

body.en:
They do not chase studio utopia. They turn Blues body and threat into a touring brand you can recognize from the walk alone.

The sixties need both lines—workshop and street—or the decade collapses into a single myth.
body.zh:
他们不追录音室乌托邦。他们把 Blues 的身体与威胁感做成巡回品牌——走路姿态就能认出来。

六十年代需要两条线——工坊与街道——否则整个十年会塌成单一神话。

body.en:
Jones, Taylor, Wood—guitar chairs change; the mouth and the riff engine stay. Watts keeps the swing secret until he cannot.

Name the peak casts you remember. The Stones story is longevity with a pulse, not a frozen yearbook photo.
body.zh:
Jones、Taylor、Wood——吉他席位在换；嘴与 riff 引擎留下。Watts 把摇摆当秘密守到守不住为止。

叫得出的巅峰卡司才值得冻结。Stones 故事是带脉搏的长寿，不是冻住的年鉴照片。

body.en:
One fuzz riff and global youth culture shares a melody for impatience. Satisfaction is not a complaint letter; it is a motor that will not idle.

Hard Rock later turns up the weight. This is where the fidget becomes anthem.
body.zh:
一道失真 riff，全球青年文化有了共同的焦躁旋律。Satisfaction 不是投诉信，是一台不肯怠速的发动机。

后来 Hard Rock 加重重量。焦躁变成国歌，是从这里开始。

title.en: Gimme Shelter: the decade's shadow peak

body.en:
Late-sixties violence and disillusionment enter the harmony. Merry Clayton's cry cuts across the band like weather breaking a window.

Hard Rock's mass is rehearsed here—one of the bridges toward Zeppelin's storm.
body.zh:
六十年代末的暴力与幻灭写进和声。Merry Clayton 的喊声横切乐队，像天气砸破窗户。

Hard Rock 的重量在此预演——通向 Zeppelin 风暴的桥之一。

body.en:
Watts is the secret weapon: jazz pocket inside rock swagger. Jagger/Richards hold the axis while decades of fashion try to sand them smooth.

They age in public without surrendering the dirty center. That refusal is the narrative.
body.zh:
Watts 是秘密武器：摇滚嚣张里的爵士口袋。Jagger/Richards 守住轴心，几十年时尚想把他们磨圆。

他们公开变老，却不交出肮脏的中心。拒绝本身就是叙事。

body.en:
Zeppelin scales the dirt into myth. Arctic Monkeys later write nightclub observation with Stones DNA in the walk.

Swing and danger keep showing up on the modern axis—less costume, same posture.
body.zh:
Zeppelin 把脏放大成神话。Arctic Monkeys 后来写夜店观察，走路姿态里仍有 Stones DNA。

摇摆与危险不断出现在近代主轴上——少了戏服，姿态还在。

note.en: Long-haul version: swing as identity, cast evolves slowly.
note.zh: 长跑版本：摇摆即身份，卡司缓慢演进。

note.en: Fuzz riff as attitude: blues swagger for the charts.
note.zh: Fuzz riff 即态度：把 Blues 傲气送上榜单。

note.en: Longevity template: keep the groove, change the clothes.
note.zh: 长寿模板：groove 不变，衣服常换。
